subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “The building still offered quiet, help, and community.”?
options: The library became a place where knowledge moved in two directions, not just from older to younger.
The old swing reminded everyone that a place can change without losing its story.
A book can travel through a screen, but a library is also a place.
A dark screen may hide laziness, but it may also hide a real problem.
